title: Cody vs. Brodie Lee: the Dark Order strikes
summary: Brodie Lee overwhelms Cody and his allies, leading to a dog-collar title rematch.

chapters.title: Brodie takes the TNT title
chapters.result: Lee decisively defeats Cody; the Dark Order attack the Nightmare Family.
chapters.context: The title change becomes a faction-wide humiliation.

chapters.title: Cody’s dog-collar comeback
chapters.result: Cody defeats Lee in a dog-collar match to regain the TNT title.
chapters.context: The chained rematch reverses Cody’s earlier defeat.
